failure.description: The bounded asynchronous VM create timed out, then the one-shot exact-instance reconciliation describe command also timed out. The uncaught second timeout terminated the evaluation campaign.

second_failure.description: The first remediation retried exact-instance reconciliation successfully, but a single 30-second timeout while polling the zonal operation was still treated as the full 300-second operation timeout. Reconciliation found no exact instance and failed closed, stopping three partial reruns.

scientific_impact.assessment: No metric receipt was produced from the interrupted campaign. Recovery reuses only completed shard terminals and outputs; interrupted shards are rerun. The final evaluation receipt still requires the exact 3-suite by 4-shard set and binds every shard output hash.

changes: Reduced future evaluation capacity retry backoff from 600 seconds to 60 seconds.
Retry exact-instance reconciliation three times before failing closed when gcloud describe itself times out.
Retry transient per-call GCE operation polling timeouts within the bounded 300-second operation deadline instead of entering reconciliation after the first slow CLI call.
